summary: Frontend-focused live retest completed for Tile Orders UX Restoration P0 fixes. Verified on desktop and phone that rapid post-login navigation no longer triggers aborted POST /api/followups/reconcile, and no console error logs were captured. Customer operations table now shows DISPATCHED and DELIVERED as visually distinct with the new delivery-confirmation note.

integration_issues.flow: Aggressive dashboard -> Tile Orders route switching
integration_issues.issue: Observed multiple aborted dashboard GET requests (followups/mission, followups list, dashboard stats, payments stats, recent quotations, shortages) during very rapid navigation. Targeted reconcile POST abort is fixed; this is a separate route-change cancellation behavior.

action_items: Optional hardening: suppress expected aborted dashboard GET noise during very fast route changes (AbortController-aware logging/filtering) so network panel remains clean under stress navigation.

Do a quick manual sanity pass on one customer order with actionable stock to visibly reconfirm Move/Dispatch buttons on live data (current sampled order was fully delivered and showed no actionable controls by design).
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.tsx and followups.tsx no longer issue fire-and-forget reconcile POST during bootstrap/load; this aligns with the reported fix scope.
tiles/orders/[id].tsx delivered cell mapping now renders em dash unless current_location is Delivered, and includes explicit delivery-confirmation note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use owner credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Reconcile-abort fix validated specifically for POST /api/followups/reconcile on desktop+phone rapid nav; no aborted reconcile request seen. UI screenshot evidence shows DISPATCHED value and DELIVERED em dash plus delivery note on customer detail.
rca_of_issue: RCA verified for reported bug #1: previous background reconcile mutation during bootstrap/navigation caused aborted POST noise; after removing auto reconcile calls, no aborted /api/followups/reconcile was observed in this retest. Bug #2 is fixed in UI mapping logic: Delivered column now derives from existing Delivered state and not directly mirroring dispatched in all cases.
